- Runtime downloads: Download and configure Codex, DeepSeek Harness, and CodebaseMemory from Direct Settings, with automatic verification, green version badges when updates are available, and confirmation before reinstalling or downgrading. DeepSeek supports mirror downloads with fallback to the official source and percentage progress. Rechecking shows configuration and version feedback beside the button while preserving the displayed version and path to keep the layout stable
- Third-party dependencies: Up

- Follow Graph experience: Adds avatar fade-in with uniform node sizes, a fixed initial viewport, a simplified toolbar, compact two-line profile cards, clearer loading and refresh feedback, and better performance through incremental visible-relationship maintenance and native path-count caching.

### New

- Issue AI summaries: Open a glass panel from the floating button above the input area's divider, drag its top edge to adjust height, and read a streaming Markdown summary; generation continues when hidden or you switch Issues, and reopening restores progress or results.
- Free source tools: Repository context packing, CodeFlow, and CodebaseMemory code graphs no longer require Pro, with existing repository and runtime limits retained.

### Improvements

- Settings redesign: Reorganizes configuratio

### New

- Development update channel: Direct users can opt into signed and notarized preview releases in Settings, while Stable remains the default.
- Linux.do discovery: Browse verified open-source projects promoted on Linux.do with language subcategories, see provenance badges across repository lists, and open the original discussion directly from the source badge in repository details.
- Quick search across lists: Expand the middle-column search field to quickly find repositories and activity items acro

- Initial tag taxonomy: When the tag library is empty, analyzes all starred repositories locally with visible phase and progress feedback, then lets you confirm a controlled vocabulary before reviewing repository assignments—no AI provider required.

### New

- Repository file download: Browse the file tree from repository details, preview source and images, then download selected files including Git LFS.
- System screensaver: Direct can install the Owner avatar wall as a macOS screensaver, then install, update, or remove it in Settings. Cells show artwork only.
- App Store data import: On first launch, Direct can copy the official App Store library, notes, and caches on this Mac, or skip and start fresh. Apple subscriptions are not copied.
- External S
- Semantic search feedback: The search footer shows retrieval progress, semantic match scores, and vector coverage, and semantic recall now includes README content.

- Unified Search Center: Combines keyword and semantic retrieval in one entry, adopts the new search field, and keeps index status and refresh feedback visible.
- Local search coverage: Search Center's local results include every repository already cached in the database, including unstarred My Projects and private repos.
- Semantic search feedback: Restores search status and the index refresh action.

Starcat 1.6.0 focuses on performance and detail polish: lower background load at launch, smoother scrolling and long lists, and lighter rendering in high-frequency views. It also adds a privacy settings page and an Owner profile card, brings OrcaRouter models and Firecrawl search, and continues refining Settings, Knowledge Base, and sharing.

### New

- README Star history: Public repository details show a full-history Star chart starting at creation, with total stars, compact axis labels, light and dark th

- Desktop widgets: Focus, Repository Rediscovery, Collection Trend, and Release Watch have clearer hierarchy and heatmap layouts. Sparse large-size variants have been removed.
- Interface details: Shortcut modifiers and primary keys use separate keycaps, the empty Activity detail guides selection, and suggested tags use clearer rows and hover feedback.
- Account data isolation: Restoring a cached session switches to the matching account database before publishing the signed-in state, avoiding temporary read

# Trace v0.2.0 — indexing & performance overhaul

Local multimodal semantic search for your files, powered by Google EmbeddingGemma 2 (int8 ONNX, fully offline).

## What's new / 更新内容

**Indexing v2 / 索引 v2**
- Adaptive + content-aware sampling; per-file fingerprint and content dedup / 自适应采样 + 内容感知 + 按文件指纹 + 内容去重
- Video scene mode: keyframe-only decoding + aHash scene detection with cap-based thinning / 视频抽帧改场景模式：仅解码关键帧 + aHa
- Single-file SQLite index: FTS5 (trigram BM25) + sqlite-vec (cosine), z-score fusion ranking
